metadata.title: COSU Enrollment / Registration Kiosk SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Enrollment and Registration Kiosks as constrained endpoint execution environments for student onboarding and registration workflows.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to enrollment, registration, and onboarding workflows, enabling students or participants to complete approved self-service transactions in a controlled environment.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Enrollment and Registration Kiosks inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for enrollment and registration transactions.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved enrollment, registration, onboarding, and identity verification applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Users authenticate transiently (e.g., application number, one-time credentials, or federated login) without persistent local accounts.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Enrollment and Registration Kiosks are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Kiosks are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and reset between sessions.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management integrity, secure communication, and workflow trust, not for granting endpoint privilege.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, general productivity software, removable media, local file access, and unauthorized applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: User sessions are fully isolated and automatically cleared at logout, completion, or timeout.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved enrollment systems, identity verification services, secure storage endpoints, and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Personally identifiable or registration data must not be persisted locally beyond transient, encrypted in-memory use.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Enrollment and Registration Kiosks may participate only in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Enrollment and registration functionality does not imply trust as an administrative workstation or eligibility for higher-classification data.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Enrollment and Registration Kiosks must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery during enrollment and onboarding periods.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Kiosk health, transaction state, configuration drift, and misuse attempts are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Enrollment and Registration Kiosks support deterministic reset, periodic reimage, and auditable lifecycle workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Enrollment and Registration Kiosks implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on transactional integrity, privacy protection, and minimal data exposure.

roles.title: Enrollment Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration, availability, and workflow support of Enrollment and Registration Kiosks.

roles.title: Admissions and Registration Governance
roles.remarks: Approves enrollment workflows, identity verification mechanisms, and exception handling.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance for Enrollment and Registration Kiosks.

control-implementation.remarks: Enrollment and Registration Kiosk implementations are OS- and platform-specific (kiosk-mode Windows/macOS/Linux or dedicated appliances) and are maintained as tightly controlled, versioned configuration baselines.
